ns2:section.sectionText: Students who wish to complete this course must seek approval from the Office of Engineering Graduate, Professional and Online Programs by completing the form located at https://grainger.illinois.edu/academic/graduate/cpt. International students on F1 visa must seek CPT approval at all levels to be eligible for a CPT experience. For information on the CPT process, please visit www.isss.illinois.edu/students/employment/f1cpt.html. S/U grading only. Range IV tuition and applicable fees apply.
